value.message: Kids & Me Drop-In at the Halton Hills Library Acton Branch is free, Thursdays 1 to 2:30pm from the 2nd week of Sept, up to age 6 - Halton Region Public Health says. EarlyON Centres in Acton and Georgetown are free from birth to 6 per Links2Care; I could not get into their pages today for days and times, so I'll keep watching and text you when I can.
